# France Guide

> > Comprehensive travel guide to France covering regions from Paris and the French Riviera to Brittany, Normandy, Loire Valley, Alsace, Corsica, and the French Antilles.

France Guide provides detailed destination guides, accommodation recommendations, cultural insights, and practical travel information for exploring France's diverse regions, historic landmarks, and coastal destinations. The site covers major attractions like the Eiffel Tower, Loire Valley castles, Provence beaches, and regional cuisine and festivals.

## Key Topics

- Paris
- French Riviera
- Provence
- Loire Valley
- Brittany
- Normandy
- Alsace
- Corsica
- French Antilles
- Travel planning
- Accommodation and hotels
- Regional cuisine and wines
- Cultural festivals
- Beaches and coastal destinations
- Historic castles and monuments

## Major Regions & Destinations

- [Brittany - Must-see sights and attractions](https://www.franceguide.info/brittany): Brittany region guide: coastal cliffs, medieval villages & Celtic culture
- [Corsica - Must-see sights and attractions](https://www.franceguide.info/corsica): Corsica guide: Mediterranean beaches, GR20 hiking & island attractions
- [Strasbourg - Things to do and travel guide](https://www.franceguide.info/alsace/strasbourg): Strasbourg travel guide: Gothic cathedral, old town & Christmas markets
- [Nice - Things to do and travel guide](https://www.franceguide.info/provence/cote-dazur/nice): Nice travel guide: French Riviera capital, belle epoque & nightlife

## Paris Travel Information

- [Best hotels in the centre of Paris](https://www.franceguide.info/paris/where-to-stay-in-paris/paris-hotels): Central Paris hotel guide: booking tips & best value accommodations
- [Events in Paris](https://www.franceguide.info/paris/paris-events): Paris event calendar: festivals, concerts & cultural celebrations
- [Gare de Lyon - Tickets, opening hours and useful info](https://www.franceguide.info/paris/paris-transport/gare-de-lyon): Gare de Lyon station info: connections, schedules & nearby lodging
- [Galeries Lafayette - Tickets, opening hours and useful info](https://www.franceguide.info/paris/things-to-do-in-paris/galeries-lafayette): Galeries Lafayette info: Art Nouveau shopping, hours & visitor details

## Loire Valley & Historic Castles

- [Amboise - Things to do and travel guide](https://www.franceguide.info/loire-valley/amboise): Amboise guide: Royal castle, Leonardo da Vinci's Clos Lucé & Renaissance
- [Castle of Azay le Rideau - Tickets, opening hours and useful info](https://www.franceguide.info/loire-valley/loire-valley-castles/azay-le-rideau-castle): Azay-le-Rideau Castle: Renaissance chateau tickets, hours & tours
- [Flights to the Loire](https://www.franceguide.info/loire-valley/loire-flights): Loire Valley flights: airlines via Paris CDG/Orly & Nantes airports

## French Riviera & Mediterranean Coast

- [Menton - Things to do and travel guide](https://www.franceguide.info/provence/cote-dazur/menton): Menton guide: Lemon Festival, baroque architecture & Riviera gardens
- [Porquerolles - How to get there, accommodation and beaches](https://www.franceguide.info/provence/cote-dazur/hyeres/porquerolles): Complete guide to Porquerolles island: beaches, transport & lodging

## Normandy & Brittany

- [Honfleur - Things to do and how to get there](https://www.franceguide.info/normandy/calvados/honfleur): Honfleur guide: historic port, colorful houses & Normandy attractions
- [Events and festivals in Normandy](https://www.franceguide.info/normandy/events-festivals-normandy): Normandy cultural calendar: festivals, medieval events & reenactments
- [Paimpont Forest - Things to do and how to get there](https://www.franceguide.info/brittany/ille-et-vilaine/paimpont-forest): Broceliande Forest guide: Arthurian legends, hiking & Druidic sites
- [Bigouden - Things to do and how to get there](https://www.franceguide.info/brittany/finistere/bigouden): Bigouden area guide: authentic Breton culture in Finistère

## Regional Cuisine & Culture

- [What to eat in Alsace, typical dishes and wines](https://www.franceguide.info/alsace/typical-food-wines-alsace): Alsatian cuisine guide: traditional dishes, wines & gastronomic tips
